steps.en: Install the driver once, then point an agent at it
steps.zh: 装好驱动，把 agent 接上

steps.en: Optionally claim a disposable desktop so actions skip your machine
steps.zh: 可选地领一台可丢弃的桌面，别碰真机

steps.en: Runs as a process that speaks MCP over stdio
steps.zh: 作为进程运行，走 stdio 上的 MCP

steps.en: Reads window and accessibility state, then sends OS-level input in the background
steps.zh: 读窗口与无障碍状态，后台发系统级输入

steps.en: Runs that desktop and destroys it when the run ends
steps.zh: 跑那台桌面，运行结束就销毁

steps.en: Hands action results and screenshots back to the agent loop
steps.zh: 把动作结果和截图交回 agent 循环

value.en: You get OS-level reach across any app or dialog without hand-building the VM, screenshot loop, and input plumbing
value.zh: 不用自己拼 VM、截图管线和输入通路，就能覆盖任意应用与系统弹窗

sources: README.md — driver install scripts (curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh | bash; Windows: irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex) and 'Connect through the CLI, MCP, or typed SDKs. Background delivery lets agents work without moving your pointer'
libs/cua-driver/README.md — 'Speaks MCP over stdio'; 'cua-driver mcp'; 'cua-driver call'; permission modes standard/bounded/unrestricted; 'cua-driver mcp --grant existing-profile'
libs/python/cua-sandbox/README.md — Sandbox.ephemeral / Sandbox.create with cpu= and memory_mb=, pool claims, and the unsandboxed Localhost.connect() path
README.md — Cua Fleets at run.cua.ai: 'your code claims a desktop from a pool and uses the Sandbox SDK to run commands, capture screenshots, and interact with apps inside it'
